review_scope: Source protocol membership and current reporting/inventory correspondence; not anatomical certification or evidence of every representation being complete.
numerical_basis: All 56,873,096 voxels were checked in the existing source-hierarchy proof: each provided coarse volume equals the protocol parent mapping of the fine atlas, with zero disagreements.
spatial_units: Coarse headers leave units unspecified; millimetres are inherited only from their exact array correspondence and numerically identical sform to the fine source, which declares millimetres.

compositions.display_name: Right insular cortex — anterior and posterior source labels
compositions.why_this_improves_representation: Separates the insula-labelled children from the source parent’s opercular labels.
compositions.remaining_limit: Source label extent still requires anatomical boundary review.
compositions.construction: Set union of listed exact fine masks, recomputing only exposed union boundary faces; native image overlay maps those same codes.

compositions.display_name: Right opercular cortex — central, frontal and parietal source labels
compositions.why_this_improves_representation: Displays the parts that must not be silently included in pure-insula selection.
compositions.remaining_limit: Not all anatomically defined opercular tissue is proven by these three source labels.
compositions.construction: Set union of listed exact fine masks, recomputing only exposed union boundary faces; native image overlay maps those same codes.

rejected_shortcuts: Do not combine the entire insular parent with a pure-insula requirement.
Do not restore a supposed complete brainstem by blindly adding all bilateral pBrain labels.
Do not relabel cerebral WM as individual capsules, tracts, centrum semiovale or corona radiata.
Do not use lobar-GM masks as arterial territory maps.
Do not call the vessels/connective residual an artery, vein, sinus, dura or cranial-nerve model.
